Do not be deceived: the rock guards its secrets well. }} [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]]. ==Getting There== *From [[Amnoon Oasis]] follow the road South. At the first fork take the East path and follow the road to the [[teleporter]]. After activating and using the teleporter follow the path South East and at the first fork take the North path. Follow the path around back to the South until you arrive at a crossroads. Follow the Eastern path to the [[portal]]. *The quest [[Sands Of Souls]] will bring you here. ==Mission== *[[Augury Rock]] **This mission is the eighteenth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the fourth mission in the [[Crystal Desert]] region. ==Quests available== *[[Marchena]] **[[Ghostly Vengeance]] *[[Jorn Kudebeh]] **[[Into the Unknown]] ==NPCs== ===Services=== *{{x}} 24 [[Great Ritual Priest Zahmut]] ([[mission starter]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Sidon]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Zaishen Scout]] ([[Embark Beach]]) ====Henchmen==== :''(all level 17)'' *{{w}} [[Little Thom]] (Brawler) *{{w}} [[Stefan]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Reyna]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Alesia]] (Healer) *{{mo}} [[Lina]] (Protector) *{{n}} [[Claude]] (Cultist) *{{me}} [[Dunham]] (Enchanter) *{{e}} [[Orion]] (Mage) ====Other allies==== *{{x}} 10 [[Aurek the Scarab Hunter]] *{{x}} 24 [[Jorn Kudebeh]] *{{x}} 15 [[Marchena]] ==Notes== *Until you have completed the missions [[Dunes of Despair]], [[Elona Reach]] and [[Thirsty River]], Augury Rock is displayed as an outpost. *Complete exploration of Augury Rock contributes 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. {{Towns and outposts in the Crystal Desert}}
